Game Overview

Friends Battle Eat A Food is a two-player game built around dive into a fast-paced duel with edible stakes. Devour falling apples to grow while dodging the poisonous ones that shrink you. With only 120 seconds to dominate, outwit your friend by cleverly maneuvering, hitting, and blocking their path to victory in this addictive two-player challenge.
